title: DataPilot AI
subtitle: AI Data Analyst Agent
tagline: Ask questions. Analyze data. Discover insights.
demo_note: Demo data is synthetic and does not represent real business records.
waiting: Upload a file or choose the demo dataset to see its profile.
quality_note: Data Quality Score is a rule-based heuristic for a quick check.
quality_good: No quality deductions were triggered by the current rules.
error: Could not load this file. Check its format, encoding, column names, and size (maximum 20 MiB).
profile_error: Could not profile this dataset. Check the uploaded data.
requires_categorical_numeric: At least one categorical and one numeric column are required.
requires_date_numeric: A recognized date column and a numeric column are required.
no_agent_notice: The Agent uses controlled analysis tools and is unavailable without a configured model.
unexpected_tool_error: The tool encountered an unexpected error. Please retry.
quality_desc_many_unknown: {rate:.2f}% of fields could not be assigned a reliable semantic type.
quality_desc_some_unknown: {rate:.2f}% of fields could not be assigned a reliable semantic type.
quality_desc_unknown: {rate:.2f}% of fields could not be assigned a reliable semantic type.
llm_config_incomplete: LLM configuration is incomplete. Check LLM_API_KEY, LLM_BASE_URL, and LLM_MODEL in .env.
llm_scope: This sends one text prompt only. It does not read the active dataset, call analysis tools, or keep conversation memory.
demo_mode_notice: Demo Mode is active. Submitting displays a fixed Demo notice; it does not call a model or invent an analysis.
demo_response_label: Demo response (fixed notice, not generated by AI)
llm_timeout: The model request timed out. Try again later.
llm_request_failed: The model request failed. Check the configuration or retry later.
agent_description: Ask a data question in natural language. The model can only select registered analysis tools; it cannot execute code.
agent_demo_unavailable: No LLM is configured. Agent is unavailable; no AI analysis is fabricated and no tools are called.
agent_config_unavailable: LLM configuration is incomplete. Check API key, base URL, and model.
agent_dataset_required: Load Demo data or upload a CSV/Excel file first.
agent_query: What would you like to analyze?
langsmith_disabled: Disabled. LLM and Agent behavior is unchanged.
langsmith_incomplete: Tracing is enabled but a valid LANGCHAIN_API_KEY or endpoint configuration is missing; no traces are sent.
langsmith_unavailable: LangSmith SDK is unavailable. The app continues to work without sending traces.
langsmith_privacy_note: When enabled, the user question and safe summaries are sent to LangSmith; DataFrames and full tool results are excluded.
database_disabled: MySQL is not configured; metadata is not persisted.
database_unavailable: MySQL is unavailable; analysis continues with in-memory data.
database_fallback_note: Metadata persistence failed. The dataset remains in session memory; Pandas analysis and the Agent continue to work.
claim_downgraded_note: {count} finding(s) lacked tool evidence and were automatically downgraded to hypotheses, so they are not shown as facts.
structured_missing_note: This answer was not returned as a structured conclusion. The model's raw narrative is shown below; check it against the tool results in the analysis steps.
agent_partial_note: Only evidence that was actually computed is shown. Unfinished steps are never invented.
kb_dimension_mismatch: The existing knowledge index was built with different dimensions than the configured EMBEDDING_DIMENSIONS. Pandas analysis and the Agent are unaffected; rebuild the index to use the knowledge base (this clears all indexed chunks, so re-index your documents afterwards).
kb_rebuild_done: Knowledge index rebuilt. Re-index the documents you need.
kb_rebuild_failed: Rebuilding the knowledge index failed. Check local storage permissions and retry.
